pages.https://emberfall.example/wiki/Tidecalle:
Tidecaller

The Tidecaller is a water and air caster from the coast of Emberfall. Main attributes: Intelligence (spell damage) and Wits (critical chance and initiative). Constitution gives health.

Skills

Rain Bolt (level 1): water damage, makes the target wet. Gust (level 1): air damage, knocks back. Healing Tide (level 2): heals over two turns. Fog Veil (level 3): makes you invisible for one turn. Static Lash (level 4): air damage that stuns wet targets. Undertow (level 6): pulls an enemy to you. Storm Call (level 8): a storm over an area for three turns. Hail Lance (level 9): heavy water damage. Tempest Shield (level 10): absorbs damage. Maelstrom (level 12, capstone): a whirlpool that drags enemies together.

Civil skills

Lore (identify items, see enemy resistances), Persuasion (better quest rewards), Bartering (better prices), Lucky Charm (more loot).

Talents

Talents come at levels 1, 3, 7 and 11. Lone Current: doubles attribute points while you travel alone. Far Caster: more range on spells. Elemental Ranger: water and air spells cost less. Tidal Echo: a second cast of your last spell at half strength.
pages.https://questlog.example/tidecaller-solo:
Solo Tidecaller, levels 1 to 4

Character creation: start as a Saltborn for the water resistance. Intelligence 14, Wits 12, Constitution 10. Take Lone Current at creation: it doubles attribute points when you travel alone, which is the whole point of a solo run.

Level 1: Rain Bolt and Gust. Level 2: Healing Tide. Level 3: Fog Veil, and the talent Far Caster. Level 4: Static Lash: wet them with Rain Bolt, then stun them. Civil: put your first points in Lore.

I'll cover level 5 and up in a later post.
